scope: Conditional research scenarios, not a ranked optimal policy

scenarios.objective: Improve personal learning, economy, or an existing network before expanding it
when: The same site instance already belongs to the acting Faith.
Fresh context confirms the intended county/building holder, Active/rarity, and benefit recipient.
scenarios.decision: Do not submit duplicate adopt; compare existing Baghdad management/promotion with a new site.
scenarios.comparison: Historical Baghdad14 already belonged to Faith50, county holder was player15893, current Active and rarity2 were observed in R4. Eminent-only declared effects can make promotion a candidate, subject to capacity, lost major benefits, fresh native permission and price.
does_not_prove: Promotion is currently legal.
Baghdad is the optimal choice.
Any declared modifier was measured as applied.

scenarios.objective: Gain personal learning or personal income immediately
when: Target county is held by a vassal rather than the player.
Target is empty/inactive and no independent building or pilgrimage payoff has been verified.
scenarios.decision: Do not value adoption as immediate personal learning/income; require a named recipient and a complete activation/use plan.
scenarios.comparison: Nadjaf local fixed declaration is clergy_opinion+3 for the county holder, not learning for the adopting emperor. In R8 that holder was15436 and rarity0; scaled relic terms therefore have no positive magnitude in that observed evaluation.
does_not_prove: Adoption has no strategic value.
Inactive fixed modifiers definitely apply.
A later recognized relic or independent building benefit is impossible.

scenarios.objective: Seek the Nadjaf eminent Faith-wide piety/clergy package
when: The acting Faith does not yet own the target.
The desired type effect is in an eminent-only block.
Full major capacity may require a different existing major to be demoted.
scenarios.decision: Price the complete sequence and the benefit lost at the old major; adoption alone does not purchase the eminent package.
scenarios.comparison: With no free actions and all fresh quotes1000: planned adopt+demote+promote=3000 piety, not a measured three-action bundle. On historical C2 adoption was already sunk; R7 measured the remaining demote26+promote32 at2000. A recognized relic creates a further artifact opportunity cost, and later removal was independently paid500 in R7.
does_not_prove: Free action count is zero now.
Devotion falls by the wallet amount.
Demoting Mecca is best.
The package has already increased anyone’s net stats.

scenarios.objective: Satisfy one missing enabling condition of a specific existing special building
when: A built Imam Ali Mosque is actually present.
Its own holding holder has the acting Faith and meets the Islam/syncretism branch.
The missing condition is the barony’s holy-site association with that holder Faith.
Fresh final native adoption permission, quote and post-building state are available.
scenarios.decision: Adoption can be justified by satisfying the missing relation predicate; verify final enabled state and the actual building beneficiary afterward.
scenarios.comparison: Imam Ali Mosque uses membership AND Islam/syncretism. This is a building-specific gate, independent of calling a site eminent or relic Active. An unbuilt mosque still needs gold, construction, a suitable slot and other construction requirements.
does_not_prove: The historical Nadjaf building exists or is disabled.
A building is constructed by adoption.
The county holder and holding holder are the same person.
All special buildings use this AND.

scenarios.objective: Choose a type/location whose local benefit recipient is the player
when: Fresh creation context offers the exact type, barony and qualifying artifact tuple.
The player actually holds the county and intends to invest there.
The budget includes piety, relic use elsewhere, major capacity if needed, and creation cooldown.
scenarios.decision: Compare a player-held wisdom site with adopting a vassal-held site, using actual recipients and chosen goals rather than the site count alone.
scenarios.comparison: R8 created ordinary326 at barony6622 for2000 actual piety, Active4 with237 owned by the site. Its type declares county-holder learning2 and scaled local construction costs; eminent-only XP remains unavailable through ordinary status. For a Sunni building holder, Samarra Great Mosque’s Islam OR holy-site branch already satisfies the religion alternative, so creation is unnecessary merely to satisfy that branch.
does_not_prove: The current building holder/enable state is known.
A current capital can be used for pilgrimage.
The new type has produced measured net learning/development.
All artifacts or type/barony pairs qualify.
The earlier abandonment was necessary for creation.

scenarios.objective: Improve an actually usable pilgrimage option
when: Fresh activity location logic exposes the candidate for this host and pilgrimage type.
Host health, recent visits, travel route, expense and safety meet the current plan.
The site is not excluded as the non-adventurer host’s own capital.
scenarios.decision: Value destination relevance only after the actual activity candidate and location validity are checked.
scenarios.comparison: Hajj remains Mecca-only. A wisdom site in Samarra cannot replace Hajj; if Samarra is the current capital, the ordinary landed host capital exclusion also matters. Adding an association does not prove a free, safe, immediately available pilgrimage.
does_not_prove: Any pilgrimage was executed in this episode.
An inactive site is always a valid destination.
The historical actor’s current capital has been read.
